description: Image Description: The image shows a stainless steel countertop oven with a digital display panel on the front. The display is illuminated in blue and shows a temperature setting of 400°F, along with the number "11" below it, possibly indicating a timer or cooking mode. The oven has several control knobs and buttons: a large central dial labeled "TEMP" for adjusting temperature, a smaller dial below it labeled "TIME," and a red-ringed button labeled "START/CANCEL."
